basics.name: Fardin Abdi
basics.label: Principal Scientist, Amazon AGI Labs
basics.summary: Principal Scientist at Amazon AGI Labs with over a decade of experience designing, building, and leading production-grade AI/ML systems at scale. Focused on model customization for frontier models: continued pre-training with relational datasets and continual learning.

work.name: Amazon AGI Labs
highlights: Leading work on model customization, enabling customers to adapt foundation models to their domains.
Continued pre-training (CPT) with relational datasets: methods to effectively learn from structured and tabular data.
Continual learning techniques that allow models to acquire new knowledge and capabilities without catastrophic forgetting.

work.name: Stripe
highlights: Reduced high-risk merchant losses while minimizing false positives for legitimate businesses.
Architected DetectiveGPT, Stripe's LLM agent framework for automated merchant risk investigations, adopted across Sales, Compliance, Crypto, and Strategy teams.
Led delivery of ML models for delinquency, loss estimation, user value, and churn, generating $15M+/year in savings.
Drove infra robustness, live monitoring, feature pipeline quality, phased rollouts, and operational rigor.

work.name: Pinterest
work.summary: Tech Lead for the conversion modeling team.
highlights: Set technical vision, evaluation frameworks, and operational standards for the conversion modeling team.
Improved the Conversion User Match Prediction model, directly improving advertiser attribution.
Pioneered embedding-based candidate retrieval to future-proof attribution against browser privacy changes.

work.name: Uber
work.position: ML Engineer, Michelangelo Deep Learning / Uber AI
work.summary: Founding member of Uber's ML Application Framework.
highlights: Enabled code/config-driven ML workflows across Keras and PyTorch as a founding member of Uber's ML Application Framework.
Major contributor to Horovod (Linux Foundation AI): authored the horovodrun CLI launcher, fault-tolerant training, tensor fusion, and Spark Estimator integration.
Built platform efficiency tools for GPU/CPU utilization monitoring, idle job detection, and hardware benchmarking.

work.name: Capital One
work.summary: Deep learning for data profiling and synthetic data.
highlights: Built deep learning-powered data profiling and synthetic data generation libraries (GANs/RNNs); this work produced 110 granted US patents.
Developed Capital One's first-generation deep learning experimentation infrastructure.

education.summary: Dissertation: Safety and security of cyber-physical systems.

awards.title: Qualcomm Innovation Fellowship — Winner
awards.summary: $100K fellowship; one of 8 winning teams selected from 138 proposals.
